top_signals.title: U.S. Pushed Iraq and Venezuela to Consider Quitting OPEC, Sources Say
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Administration early this year encouraged two of OPEC’s five founding members, Iraq and Venezuela, to leave the cartel, Reuters reported on Friday, quoting multiple sources with knowledge of the matter. Iraq and Venezuela have brushed aside this push from the Trump Administration, so far. The U.S. Administration wanted oil production in both Iraq and Venezuela to increase, and was concerned that the OPEC and OPEC+ agreements and production quotas would hamstring any output gains.
